treatment_summary: Start low‑dose ramipril and atorvastatin as first‑line therapy for hypertension, proteinuria, and cardiovascular risk per NICE NG203. Add amlodipine if BP remains uncontrolled. Address CKD‑related anaemia with iron repletion followed by epoetin alfa once Hb <10 g/dL. Avoid contraindicated drugs (NSAIDs, metformin, ACE‑I/ARB combo, lithium, unprotected IV contrast). Monitor renal function, electrolytes, liver enzymes, lipids, haemoglobin and iron parameters at recommended intervals.
